g1.flow: 31 times, in blocks of 8-7-8-8. Creation (8): grain, jinn, two sunrises, two seas, pearls, ships, the Face that remains, 'every day a matter'. The Day (7): 'We will attend to you', 'pass if you can', fire, sky split, none asked, criminals seized, scalding water. Two gardens (8), ending 'reward for good'. Two lower gardens (8), ending on green cushions. First pair: reclining, then women; lower pair: women, then reclining.

cues.55:13: 1st, creation 1/8: after grain with husks and scented plants; man from clay follows.
cues.55:16: 2nd, creation 2/8: after jinn from smokeless fire; next, Lord of the two sunrises.
cues.55:18: 3rd, creation 3/8: after two sunrises and two sunsets; the two seas follow.
cues.55:21: 4th, creation 4/8: after the barrier between the two seas; pearl and coral follow.
cues.55:23: 5th, creation 5/8: after pearl and coral from the seas; next, ships like mountains.
cues.55:25: 6th, creation 6/8: after ships raised like mountains; next, everyone on earth perishes.
cues.55:28: 7th, creation 7/8: after the Face of your Lord remains, Owner of Majesty and Honor.
cues.55:30: 8th, creation ends: after 'every day He is in a matter'; 'We will attend' follows.
cues.55:32: 9th, the Day 1/7: after 'We will attend to you, O prominent beings'.
cues.55:34: 10th, Day 2/7: after 'O company of jinn and mankind… then pass'; fire follows.
cues.55:36: 11th, Day 3/7: after a flame of fire and smoke sent upon you.
cues.55:38: 12th, Day 4/7: after the heaven splits open, rose-colored like oil.
cues.55:40: 13th, Day 5/7: after 'that Day none will be asked about his sin'.
cues.55:42: 14th, Day 6/7: after criminals seized by forelocks and feet; next, 'This is Hell'.
cues.55:45: 15th, Day 7/7: after scalding water, two ayat past 'This is Hell'; two gardens follow.
cues.55:47: 16th, gardens 1/8: after two gardens for whoever feared the position of his Lord.
cues.55:49: 17th, gardens 2/8: after 'having spreading branches'; two flowing springs follow.
cues.55:51: 18th, gardens 3/8: after two springs, flowing; next, every fruit in two kinds.
cues.55:53: 19th, gardens 4/8: after every fruit in two kinds; next, reclining on brocade beds.
cues.55:55: 20th, gardens 5/8: after reclining on silk-brocade beds, fruit hanging low.
cues.55:57: 21st, gardens 6/8: after women limiting glances, untouched by man or jinnī.
cues.55:59: 22nd, gardens 7/8: after 'as if rubies and coral'; next, reward for good.
cues.55:61: 23rd, gardens 8/8: after 'is the reward for good anything but good?'; lower gardens follow.
cues.55:63: 24th, lower gardens 1/8: after 'below them two other gardens'; next, dark green.
cues.55:65: 25th, lower 2/8: after 'dark green'; two spouting springs follow.
cues.55:67: 26th, lower 3/8: after two springs, spouting; fruit, palms and pomegranates follow.
cues.55:69: 27th, lower 4/8: after fruit, palm trees and pomegranates; good, beautiful women follow.
cues.55:71: 28th, lower 5/8: after good and beautiful women; next, fair ones in pavilions.
cues.55:73: 29th, lower 6/8: after fair ones reserved in pavilions; next, 'untouched'.
cues.55:75: 30th, lower 7/8: after 'untouched before them by man or jinnī', standing alone.
cues.55:77: 31st, last: after green cushions and fine carpets; then 'Blessed is the name of your Lord'.

g2.flow: In the first two gardens the line is whole: fīhinna qāṣirātu ṭ-ṭarf (women limiting glances), then lam yaṭmithhunna insun qablahum wa lā jānn. In the lower gardens the women (55:70) and the pavilions (55:72) get ayat of their own, and this second half stands alone at 55:74. Hook: long in the first gardens, split into three short ayat in the lower ones.

cues.55:56: Whole: fīhinna qāṣirātu ṭ-ṭarf… lam yaṭmithhunna; first gardens, a refrain after brocade beds.
cues.55:74: Short: only lam yaṭmithhunna…; lower gardens, a refrain after fair ones in pavilions.
